TIRO - NOTICE
=============

This product includes the NVIDIA Nemotron speech recognition model.

Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License

  Model:       nvidia/nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b
  ONNX export: sherpa-onnx-nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b-560ms-int8
  Supplied as int8 ONNX encoder, decoder and joiner, 560 ms streaming chunks.

The full text of the NVIDIA Open Model License is in LICENSE.txt. NVIDIA does
not endorse this application, and no NVIDIA trademark is used except to
describe the origin of the model.
